item.title: Threatening messages, and an arrest, bring antisemitism close to home for a New York rabbi
item.description: JTA – Rabbi Matt Cutler was wrapping up a local TV interview last Thursday when a text from State Police came through. The man who had been posting antisemitic threats against him online was about to be arrested. The notice was timely for Cutler, the leader of the Reform synagogue Congregation Gates of Heaven in Schenectady, New York, […]

item.title: Belgium deploys soldiers to Jewish sites as Britain charges two men with spying on Jews
item.description: JTA – Two Iranian men in Britain have been charged with allegedly spying on the Jewish community in London on behalf of Iran. The arrests come as French police say they thwarted a plot against Jewish targets by supporters of the Islamic State, and as Belgium deploys its army to patrol Jewish sites following a […]

item.title: Traumatised by their last evacuation, many in Israel’s north are staying put despite renewed danger
item.description: JTA – Daniel Dorfman had only recently reopened his pizza restaurant on a Metula kibbutz just hundreds of metres from Israel’s border with Lebanon when war broke out again. His Ayuni Pizza Bar had been closed since October 2023, when Hezbollah began waging war on Israel, turning the border region into a dangerous ghost zone. Now, Hezbollah is […]

item.title: Five more killed by Iranian missiles and shrapnel falls at Ben Gurion, curbing more flights
item.description: JTA – Five more people were killed overnight by Iranian missiles aimed at Israel: a man from Thailand in the country’s centre and four Palestinian women who had been preparing to break the Ramadan fast in their West Bank village. One was six months pregnant. The deaths come as Iran has increasingly turned to cluster munitions, […]

item.title: ‘Buffer zones’ come to California, as a lawmaker proposes limiting protests near houses of worship
item.description: JTA – A California lawmaker is introducing a bill that would create a buffer zone around houses of worship, the latest effort to respond to protests against Israel that have taken place outside synagogues. California State Assembly member Rebecca Bauer-Kahan, a Jewish Democrat representing a suburban district in the San Francisco Bay Area, unveiled AB 2664, dubbed the Safe Worship Zone […]

item.title: Birthright travellers look different after 7 October – but the effect remains the same, study shows
item.description: JTA – Len Saxe, a researcher at Brandeis University, has been studying the impact of Birthright trips to Israel since the initiative launched in 1999. Last year, he noticed something unusual in the data. At a rate far outpacing anything he’d detected before, people who signed up for Birthright in summer 2025 but didn’t participate became less connected to Israel […]

item.title: Trump administration sues Harvard for allegedly discriminating against Jewish, Israeli students
item.description: JTA – The Trump administration sued Harvard University on Friday, alleging that it had failed to address antisemitism and discrimination against Jewish and Israeli students. The lawsuit, filed by the Justice Department in Massachusetts District Court, marked a sharp escalation of the government’s year-long battle with the university as it now seeks to freeze existing grants and demand repayment of […]

item.title: In Broadway’s Giant, Roald Dahl is a warped messenger for a vital debate about Israel
item.description: JTA – Charlie and the Chocolate Factory author Roald Dahl is a terrible messenger for a serious conversation about Jews and Israel. Which is part of what makes Giant, the new Broadway play about the British writer’s 1983 antisemitic outbursts so unsettling. The play asks urgent, complicated questions about Israel, Jewish solidarity and diaspora responsibility, but it puts them in the mouth of a […]

item.title: Germany pulls support for Israel in ICJ ‘genocide’ case
item.description: JTA – Germany, an early defender of Israel against allegations of “genocide” in Gaza at the International Court of Justice (ICJ), has pulled support as it faces its own charges for aiding Israel. Germany will no longer intervene on Israel’s behalf, a spokesperson for the German Foreign Ministry told reporters on Wednesday. The U-turn comes after the German […]

item.description: JTA – President Donald Trump announced on Monday that the United States had been negotiating an end to the war in Iran for the previous two days, marking the first signal from the president of high-level talks with Tehran since the war began with joint US-Israeli strikes last month.
